Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - an owner splits a fix whose open findings include a `Not done:` finding, then closes the original fix. `src/forge/close.py:128` records a follow-up for every open finding, but its next call to `bound_review` at `src/forge/close.py:290` removes that follow-up and marks the finding required again at `src/forge/review.py:1092`. The original fix blocks again despite the recorded split; the change to carried settlements does not address this path.
